name: DASAN Networks, Inc.
summary: DASAN Networks, Inc. provides networking solutions worldwide. The company offers networking products, and solutions, such as switches, Wi-Fi routers, and FTTH equipment for internet communication companies; software for network operation management; and automobile electronics products, including switches, Ethernet cameras, AVMs, and Ethernet test equipment. It also engages in the logistic business. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
